(répond aussi à sa question sur #431 : rouvrir ou pas)
=====================================================================

Thanks for porting it and for crediting #431. I'm happy for #1969 to carry the first-use half: no need to reopen #431, since the retire half is already in main.

Thanks also for posting the weaker in-title numbers plainly. That makes sense: if `descriptor::sync_heaps` makes a host view for every slot before each submission, every texture in the heap gets its host copy at once, so first use is no longer first use by a list. On our side (RX 7600, older base) the 8.8 → 4.6 GB was measured before the heap mirror existed, which fits your explanation. Making a slot's view only when a list or a heap-indexing draw can reach it sounds like the right next step, and it belongs in its own PR.

On @catminou4's point about a first-use stall: the host texture is created either way, this only moves the cost from the title's create call to the first list that uses it. I didn't measure a hitch from it on the RX 7600, but I didn't look for one specifically either.
